description: Refactor code to extract hardcoded API key to environment variable. The workspace contains a Python project at /home/ga/workspace/weather_api_project/ with main.py that has a hardcoded API key (look for the line starting with 'API_KEY = '). You must: (1) Create a .env file in the project root containing the API key with format 'API_KEY=<key_value>' where <key_value> is the exact string from the hardcoded assignment, (2) Add '.env' to the .gitignore file to prevent committing secrets, (3) Modify main.py to import os and load_dotenv from dotenv, call load_dotenv(), and replace the hardcoded API_KEY assignment with os.getenv('API_KEY'), (4) Ensure the hardcoded secret string is completely removed from main.py. Save all files when done.
